summary: ADVERSARIAL H003: Mostly survives. (1) Bootstrap La Niña TE: CI=[0.17,0.50] excludes zero, 100% positive — SURVIVES. (2) Bin sensitivity: 5/6 bin choices yield p<0.05, n_bins=10 fails — MOSTLY SURVIVES. (3) Phase-randomized surrogates: SH→NH p<0.001, NH→SH p=0.014 — SURVIVES. H003 remains robust with minor caveats (high n_bins sensitivity).
